config.defaultTheme.description: Default color theme for the markdown preview.
config.defaultFontSize.description: Default preview font size in pixels (12-24).
config.defaultMode.description: View mode used when a markdown file is opened.
config.showOutline.description: Show the outline sidebar by default.
config.mermaidLevelColors.description: Color Mermaid diagrams (flowchart, class and state diagrams by level; sequence diagrams by actor). Off by default (monochrome). Use the ◐ button on a diagram to toggle it per document.
config.language.description: Language of the viewer's interface (toolbar, menus, dialogs, messages). Auto uses Korean when VS Code or your operating system is set to Korean, and English otherwise. Open viewers switch immediately; the top-bar EN / 한 button toggles it too.
config.language.enum.auto: Follow VS Code / operating system language
